“We Buy Phones” ad templates

Graphics Studio makes buyback ads for phone buyers, repair shops and trade-in resellers who buy iPhones, Samsung phones, iPads, MacBooks and other devices from the public. Pick a design, type your phone number and area, and download an image ready for Facebook Marketplace, OfferUp, Craigslist, Instagram or a printed flyer.

See the phones designs Pricing

How it works

  1. Pick a design. Open the phones designs and click one. It opens in the studio with its colours, product picture and copy already in place.
  2. Type your details. Your phone number, website if you have one, and your ZIP or city. Save them once in your brand kit and every design fills them in.
  3. Download and post. Choose a size (square for feeds, 9:16 for stories, 8.5×11 for print) and download. Every Phones design is on the free plan.

What to put on a phones buyback ad

  • What you buy, in the words a seller searches: iPhone, Samsung, iPad, MacBook.
  • The conditions you take (new, used, cracked screen, not turning on), and anything you do not buy, so the wrong sellers do not text.
  • How you pay: cash, Zelle and the like, and whether you meet up or pick up.
  • Your phone number, big enough to read on a phone screen, and your area.

Keep it to one headline, a few short selling points and one number. People scroll past an ad in a second; the ones that get texts are readable at a glance on a phone.

Questions

Are the phone templates free?

Yes. Every design in the Phones category is included on the free plan. The free plan gives you 3 downloads a week at 1080 pixels with a BUYBACK.AD watermark; Pro removes the watermark and raises the limit.

Can I show a price on the ad?

You can type any headline or line of text you like. If you print a price, make sure it is one you will pay, because the ad is yours and so is the promise.

Is it free?

You can design without an account. Downloading needs a free account: 3 downloads a week at 1080 pixels with a BUYBACK.AD watermark. Pro is $15 a month for 100 downloads a month up to 2160 pixels, no watermark, every design.
